instructions: Extract the numeric students-per-one-faculty component from the I-2 printed "Student to Faculty ratio" response (for example, 11 from "11 to 1"). Bind it to the I-2 reporting term printed on the form; do not substitute the CDS edition or the I-3 term. Copy the complete ratio response exactly as printed into raw_value; preserve wording and punctuation such as "to 1" or ":1" rather than normalizing them. The source defines both student and instructional-faculty FTE as full-time plus one-third part-time and excludes both students and faculty in stand-alone graduate or professional programs where faculty teach virtually only graduate-level students. It also excludes undergraduate and graduate student teaching assistants from faculty. This is not an undergraduate-only ratio and must not be confused with an institution-added "Ugrad Ratio" label some forms print near I-2, which is a separate, unverified, institution-added figure. Do not compute this value from ratio_basis_student_fte and ratio_basis_faculty_fte; extract the printed ratio independently even if it appears inconsistent with the basis values.
description: Student-to-faculty ratio printed in I-2 for the source-defined FTE student and instructional-faculty populations, after the stated stand-alone graduate/professional-program exclusions, expressed as the numeric students-per-one-faculty component.

instructions: Extract the I-2 printed FTE student count used as the ratio's basis, from the parenthetical "based on ... students" response, preserving fractional precision exactly as printed. Bind it to the I-2 reporting term printed on the form; do not substitute the CDS edition or the I-3 term. The source defines student FTE as full-time plus one-third part-time and excludes students in stand-alone graduate or professional programs where faculty teach virtually only graduate-level students. This is the I-2 basis figure only; it includes eligible undergraduate and graduate students, is not the undergraduate or total enrollment headcount reported in B1/B2, and must not be derived by multiplying students_per_faculty by ratio_basis_faculty_fte.
description: Full-time-equivalent student count printed in I-2 as the ratio basis, using full-time plus one-third part-time students after the stated stand-alone graduate/professional-program exclusions.

instructions: Extract the I-2 printed FTE faculty count used as the ratio's basis, from the parenthetical "and ... faculty" response, preserving fractional precision exactly as printed. Bind it to the I-2 reporting term printed on the form; do not substitute the CDS edition or the I-3 term. The source defines instructional-faculty FTE as full-time plus one-third part-time, excludes faculty in stand-alone graduate or professional programs where faculty teach virtually only graduate-level students, and does not count undergraduate or graduate student teaching assistants as faculty. This is not the I-1 total instructional-faculty headcount and must not be derived by dividing ratio_basis_student_fte by students_per_faculty.
description: Full-time-equivalent instructional-faculty count printed in I-2 as the ratio basis, using full-time plus one-third part-time faculty after the stated exclusions.

instructions: Extract the I-3 "Class Sections" row, "2-9" column and bind it to the I-3 reporting term printed on the form; do not use the I-2 term or CDS edition. A class section is an organized credit-bearing course identified by discipline and number, meeting at stated times in a classroom or similar setting, and not a lab, discussion, or other subsection. It is undergraduate when at least one degree-seeking undergraduate is enrolled for credit. Exclude distance-learning and noncredit classes; dissertation or thesis research, music instruction, one-to-one readings, and other individual instruction; and students in independent study, cooperative programs, internships, foreign-language taped tutor sessions, practicums, and all one-on-one classes. Count cross-listed sections once. Yale's version explicitly includes classes moved online because of COVID-19 despite the distance-learning exclusion. This is an offering count, not a student count or percentage. A visibly blank band is not_reported, never zero; a printed zero remains zero.
description: Number of undergraduate class sections with 2 to 9 students, per I-3.
